name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Income support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families.
steps: Check your eligibility on the official PM-KISAN portal.
Complete farmer registration if required.
Complete the required eKYC process.
Check your beneficiary and payment status.
verification_note: Final eligibility depends on landholding status and scheme exclusion criteria.

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for eligible students pursuing higher education.
steps: Check the current eligibility criteria on the National Scholarship Portal.
Complete One Time Registration and application requirements.
Select the PM-USP Central Sector Scheme when eligible.
Submit the required academic, income and bank details.
Track verification and application status on the portal.
verification_note: Final eligibility also depends on academic merit, regular-course status and other scheme-specific conditions.

name: PM-USP Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme
description: Interest subsidy support for eligible students taking education loans for qualifying technical or professional courses.
steps: Check whether your course and institution meet the current scheme requirements.
Check the applicable family-income condition.
Apply for the qualifying education loan.
Complete the required subsidy application process.
Verify the current status through the relevant official portal or institution.
verification_note: The scheme has specific course, institution, loan and income conditions. Verify the current rules before applying.

name: PM-Vidyalaxmi
description: Central sector education-finance support intended to help eligible students pursue higher education through qualifying education loans and interest-subvention support.
steps: Check whether your institution and admission qualify under the current scheme.
Review the applicable loan and interest-subvention conditions.
Apply through the designated PM-Vidyalaxmi process.
Submit the required academic, admission and financial documents.
Track the loan or interest-subvention status.
verification_note: Eligibility depends on the current list of qualifying institutions and scheme conditions.

name: PM YASASVI Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education in College for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
description: Higher-education support scheme listed on the National Scholarship Portal for eligible OBC, EBC and DNT students.
steps: Check the current scheme eligibility on the National Scholarship Portal.
Confirm category, income and educational requirements.
Complete the required NSP registration/application.
Upload the required documents.
Track institute and department verification.
verification_note: Category, income, institution and other scheme-specific conditions must be verified before applying.
